concept: A calm oversized pocket garden where moss, sheltering leaves, and a little water make every green detour feel restorative.
floor: One broad continuous deep-forest moss cushion across the full top face, formed from three or four softly overlapping oversized cushion lobes with extremely subtle height changes and broad forest-green-to-olive tonal shifts so it reads unmistakably as moss rather than lawn; no depressions, pits, holes, footprint-like marks, dark pools, grass blades, individual leaves, flowers, stones, fibers, or repeated texture.
main_structure: One broad leafy garden alcove at the rear, built from a few large overlapping moss and leaf masses with a clean dark opening.
rear_props: one small smooth oval pond tucked against the rear-right edge
three large rounded moss boulders grouped beside the pond
side_props: one chunky stump bench and two oversized fern silhouettes on the upper-left edge
one large watering-stone ornament and two oversized fern silhouettes on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth deep-green moss border made from broad rounded masses
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple pale leaf emblems

materials: a few broad cream limestone blocks

lighting: soft filtered daylight with two broad warm garden lanterns and gentle cool light on the pond
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open moss floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, stepping stones, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
floor depressions, pits, holes, footprint-like marks, dark pools, leaf-by-leaf texture, tiny flowers, mushrooms, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
